name: acudx-launch-video
description: AcuDx launch video, teaser and poster, rendered with Remotion

scripts.render:walkthrough: remotion render src/index.ts Walkthrough out/walkthrough.raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --browser-executable /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell
scripts.render:teaser: remotion render src/index.ts Teaser out/teaser-v2.raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --browser-executable /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell
scripts.render:square: remotion render src/index.ts Square out/square.raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --browser-executable /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell
scripts.render:v2: npm run render:walkthrough && npm run render:teaser && npm run render:square && npm run render:poster-v2 && npm run encode
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Launch out/launch.mp4 --codec h264 --browser-executable /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell
scripts.render:launch-teaser: remotion render src/index.ts LaunchTeaser out/teaser.mp4 --codec h264 --browser-executable /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194/chrome-linux/headless_shell
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:launch-teaser && npm run render:poster && npm run render:v2
